decisions.text: Chosen: V2-045A includes the single POST (7 of 9 planners) but takes the minted id as an argument so V2-045B can persist between mint and send; clock offset = max(created - receivedAt) from events whose id carries their created time, order floor from observed id ordinals (prefix = created mod 2^36 verified on capture); captured 28-char client ids are opaque replay data; another-harness session throws (Core rejects the command); unparseable 200 is uncertain; native error messages are not carried
